digest.component_or_area: test harness and conftest isolation guards
propositions: Detached pytest runs report errors on unrelated tests that do not reproduce in foreground runs, creating false positives and wasted investigation.
The _no_repo_root_leaks guard fires when a concurrent external process writes to REPO_ROOT during a test, misattributing external mutations to the test in teardown and deleting the external file.
The browser e2e probe diagnostic raises AssertionError on empty stderr without checking proc.returncode, making signal-killed children indistinguishable from product failures.
Detachment itself is not the cause; it is an enabler that allows concurrent mutations that would be blocked by a foreground run holding the agent.

The leak guard message asserts 'Test leaked new entries' falsely when no test caused the mutation, and the returncode diagnostic omits the signal number needed to distinguish external reaping from genuine failures.
